# Design Tokens

- Spacing uses the scale classes `p-1` to `p-8` and `m-1` to `m-8`. Arbitrary values such as `mt-[37px]` are not allowed.
- Colors are `brand`, `ink`, and `muted`. Raw hex values are not allowed.
- Breakpoints are `sm`, `md`, and `lg`. Every multi-column or fixed-width layout must have a rule for `md` and below.
